en.tagline: Terse answers that keep every technical fact
en.summary: This skill sets a terse reply style for the agent. Answers come first, filler is cut, and code, commands, paths, numbers and errors stay exact. It stays on for the whole session until the user says "stop caveman" or "normal mode".
problem: Agent replies often open with greetings, hedging and a recap. Each output token is billed and read, and long replies are slow to scan in a terminal.
With this skill, the reply starts with the answer and gives the reason and next step. Greetings, hedging and closing offers are removed. Negations, numbers and payload are never changed.
fit: Long coding sessions where replies are read in a terminal
Users who want short answers with exact commands, paths and errors
Cutting output tokens without losing technical detail
unfit: Tasks that need full prose explanations or tutorials
Text saved to files, commits, docs or issues, which the skill writes in plain prose
steps: Turn the mode on with `/caveman`, or a phrase such as "caveman mode" or "be brief".
Each reply leads with the answer, then the reason, then the next step.
Greetings, hedging, recaps and closing offers are removed.
Code, commands, paths, numbers and errors are copied exactly; code changes show only the changed lines plus 1-2 lines of context.
Tool runs get one line before the run, one line per phase change, and one line with the result.
Security warnings, irreversible actions and anything written outside chat use plain prose; the mode stays on until "stop caveman" or "normal mode".

zh.tagline: 简短回答，保留全部技术事实
zh.summary: 这个 skill 让智能体用简短的方式回复。先给答案，去掉废话，代码、命令、路径、数字和报错保持原样。在整个会话中一直有效，直到用户说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”。
problem: 智能体的回复常以问候、保留语气和总结开头。输出的每个 token 都要计费并被阅读，而且长回复在终端里不容易扫读。
使用这个 skill 后，回复开头就是答案，随后给出原因和下一步。问候、保留语气和结尾客套都会去掉。否定词、数字和代码等关键内容不会被改动。
fit: 在终端里阅读回复的长时间编码会话
想要简短回答，同时保留准确命令、路径和报错的用户
在不丢失技术细节的前提下减少输出 token
unfit: 需要完整文字解释或教程的任务
写入文件、提交、文档或 issue 的内容，这类内容按 skill 要求用普通文字书写
steps: 用 `/caveman` 开启，或说“caveman mode”“be brief”等短语。
每条回复先给答案，再给原因，最后是下一步。
问候、保留语气、总结和结尾的客套话都被去掉。
代码、命令、路径、数字和报错原样复制；代码修改只显示改动的行，加上 1-2 行上下文。
工具运行前给一行说明，每个阶段变化给一行，结束时给一行结果。
安全警告、不可逆操作以及写到聊天之外的内容使用普通文字；模式一直保持，直到用户说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”。
